description: This file defines the ReadableProductReview class, which extends ProductReviewEntity and includes a reference to a ReadableCustomer, representing a product review with customer details.

classes.name: ReadableProductReview
classes.description: A serializable Java class representing a product review, including a customer reference.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the ReadableCustomer associated with this review.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the ReadableCustomer for this review.
